name: Fixed Open Term Contract 2
definition: Specifies the terms of the contract in case of fixed or open interest rates.

MaturityDate.name: Maturity Date
MaturityDate.definition: Date on which the counterparties contractually agree the exchange of securities or commodities versus collateral for the closing leg (forward leg) of the secured financing transaction.

TerminationOption.name: Termination Option
TerminationOption.definition: Indication whether the counterparties to the transaction have agreed to an evergreen or extendable agreement.

OneElementPresentRule.definition: At least one element must be present.
